text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: A Junktown guard.
source_text: A Junktown guard.

text: 一个迦克镇卫兵。
source_text: 一个迦克镇卫兵。

text: This is Junktown. Nice place to live, as long as you stay on our good side
source_text: This is Junktown. Nice place to live, as long as you stay on our good side

text: 这里是迦克镇。如果你规矩点，这里就是一个很好的地方。
source_text: 这里是迦克镇。如果你规矩点，这里就是一个很好的地方。

text: Watch out for Gizmo and his cronies.
source_text: Watch out for Gizmo and his cronies.

text: 小心吉斯莫和他的人。
source_text: 小心吉斯莫和他的人。

text: I like my boss.
source_text: I like my boss.

text: 我喜欢我的老板。
source_text: 我喜欢我的老板。

text: You'd better put that away. Junktown is a friendly place, friend, and we want to keep it that way.
source_text:
You'd better put that away. Junktown is a friendly place,
 friend, and we want to keep it that way.

text: 你最好把那个收起来。迦克镇是一个和平的地方，而且我们想这样继续下去。
source_text: 你最好把那个收起来。迦克镇是一个和平的地方，而且我们想这样继续下去。

text: Put what away?
source_text: Put what away?

text: 把什么收起来？
source_text: 把什么收起来？

text: Don't tell me what to do, loser boy.
source_text: Don't tell me what to do, loser boy.

text: 别让我动手，白痴。
source_text: 别让我动手，白痴。

text: Sounds fair. By the way, what is the local law regarding weapons?
source_text: Sounds fair. By the way, what is the local law regarding weapons?

text: 听起来挺合理。顺便问问，这儿关于武器的法律是什么？
source_text: 听起来挺合理。顺便问问，这儿关于武器的法律是什么？

text: Uh oh.
source_text: Uh oh.

text: 呃 哦。
source_text: 呃 哦。

text: Your weapon, idiot. Killian won't take your arms away, but you'd better damn well keep them in your holster.
source_text: Your weapon, idiot. Killian won't take your arms away, but you'd better damn well keep them in your holster.

text: 你的武器，白痴。基利安不会缴你的械，但是你最好把你的枪乖乖地收起来。
source_text: 你的武器，白痴。基利安不会缴你的械，但是你最好把你的枪乖乖地收起来。

text: Oh, sorry.
source_text: Oh, sorry.

text: 哦，对不起。
source_text: 哦，对不起。

text: No way! I'm not putting down my shooters for nobody!
source_text: No way! I'm not putting down my shooters for nobody!

text: 没门！任何人都休想让我放下我的枪！
source_text: 没门！任何人都休想让我放下我的枪！

text: You'd better behave, since it's the law, and I enforce the law. Put your weapon away, don't draw it unless in self-defense, and you won't have a problem with us guards.
source_text: You'd better behave, since it's the law, and I enforce the law. Put your weapon away, don't draw it unless in self-defense, and you won't have a problem with us guards.

text: 你最好这么做，因为这就是法律，而且我维护着法律。把你的武器收起来，除了自卫别碰它们，何况有我们在，你是不会有麻烦的。
source_text: 你最好这么做，因为这就是法律，而且我维护着法律。把你的武器收起来，除了自卫别碰它们，何况有我们在，你是不会有麻烦的。

text: 【more】
source_text: 【more】

text: 【更多】
source_text: 【更多】

text: Disobey the law, and we will return you to the lawless wasteland - dead or alive.
source_text: Disobey the law, and we will return you to the lawless wasteland - dead or alive.

text: 违犯法律的话，我们就把你扔到没有法律的废土上去。是死是活你自己看着办。
source_text: 违犯法律的话，我们就把你扔到没有法律的废土上去。是死是活你自己看着办。

text: Sure, since you put it that way.
source_text: Sure, since you put it that way.

text: 你既然这么说，好吧。
source_text: 你既然这么说，好吧。

text: Bite your laws!
source_text: Bite your laws!

text: 滚你娘的法律！
source_text: 滚你娘的法律！

text: Well, uh, fine with me. But you'd better be careful.
source_text: Well, uh, fine with me. But you'd better be careful.

text: 好吧，呃，我同意。但是你最好小心点。
source_text: 好吧，呃，我同意。但是你最好小心点。

text: Fine, then. Heh.
source_text: Fine, then. Heh.

text: 那好。呵。
source_text: 那好。呵。

text: Good you asked. No weapons can be drawn except in self-defense. If you start a fight, it's your fault. Other than that, it's your ight to go around armed. Just don't pull a knife or gun without just cause. Have a good day.
source_text: Good you asked. No weapons can be drawn except in self-defense. If you start a fight, it's your fault. Other than that, it's your ight to go around armed. Just don't pull a knife or gun without just cause. Have a good day.

text: 问得好。除了自卫不准动用武器。如果是你先找茬，那就是你的责任。如果情况相反，反击是你的权力。没有正当理由就别碰你的刀和枪。祝你一天愉快。
source_text: 问得好。除了自卫不准动用武器。如果是你先找茬，那就是你的责任。如果情况相反，反击是你的权力。没有正当理由就别碰你的刀和枪。祝你一天愉快。

text: Thanks - you, too.
source_text: Thanks - you, too.

text: 谢谢你。
source_text: 谢谢你。

text: Hey you, no weapons! And I don't care if your momma dropped you on your head as a kid. No weapons.
source_text: Hey you, no weapons! And I don't care if your momma dropped you on your head as a kid. No weapons.

text: 嘿，你！收起武器！我不管你妈会不会像教训小孩一样敲你的脑袋。收起你的武器！
source_text: 嘿，你！收起武器！我不管你妈会不会像教训小孩一样敲你的脑袋。收起你的武器！

text: Dorf!
source_text: Dorf!

text: 呸!
source_text: 呸!

text: You earn 150 experience points for killing the guard.
source_text: You earn 150 experience points for killing the guard.

text: 因为杀死卫兵你得到150点经验值。
